items.title: 61125_Teddy Bunn oral history interview
items.q: "Didn't the good book say that Cain killed Abel?"

ctx.x: I had a feeling that was the tune.

(Singing), "I'll be ready, I'll be ready, good Lord, yes, I'll be ready when the great day comes." "Didn't the good book say that Cain killed Abel? Yes, good Lord. Hit him in the head with the leg of a table. Yes, good Lord." I forget that other, now. " -- the sun refused to shine, but I'll be ready when the great day comes." Ain't that it?
